original_finding_dispositions.assessment: The signed bridge now states gross margin about -3.4pp, expense-ratio compression about +6.7pp and net operating-margin improvement about +3.4pp. It explicitly refuses a contribution-share percentage.

Operating correctly treats Q1 orders and recognized revenue as coexisting signals with no cohort bridge. Demand still says the USD 16.1B recognized revenue means part of the orders converted during the quarter, despite simultaneously acknowledging that no order cohort is bound.

The USD 1.253B value is consistently identified as a three-line balance-sheet working-capital proxy change, not measured cash absorption; cash-flow reconciliation and AI attribution remain prohibited.
NVIDIA hyperscaler concentration and Dell issuer concentration are kept as separate facts and cannot be combined without a direct counterparty-overlap map.
Export controls remain an NVIDIA fact and a bounded upstream Dell scenario; the workpaper explicitly refuses a proven Dell transmission without geography, product and order exposure mapping.
Company gross margin is now treated as non-identifying in both directions. Product pricing power requires product price, cost, unit and mix evidence.
Supply securing and pull-forward remain possible competing explanations only. Scale and future digestion are unmeasured, the existing gap is preserved and effective authority is not_inferable.

material_residual_findings.finding: The Demand thesis says revenue has partially converted, and its second strongest counterargument says Q1 USD 16.1B recognized AI-server revenue proves that part of the Q1 orders converted during the quarter. The same workpaper states that Q1 orders and revenue have no bound order cohort. Same-quarter coexistence therefore cannot establish conversion of those orders.
material_residual_findings.business_impact: This restores the exact cohort-linkage error that R9 was meant to remove from the six-workpaper set and can make Writer report fulfillment quality as observed rather than unresolved.
material_residual_findings.required_boundary: State only that Q1 contains both a USD 24.4B demand signal and USD 16.1B realized-revenue signal. Do not say the recognized revenue converted the same-quarter orders. Preserve cohort, delivery timing, cancellation and conversion rate as unresolved.

non_blocking_findings.finding: The mechanism says slower guided revenue growth makes expense leverage narrow as an arithmetic necessity. Lower growth can reduce the probability of further leverage, but expense structure and mix can change, so narrowing is not mathematically necessary.

The workpaper correctly labels the USD 1.253B proxy, but phrases such as incremental profit being deposited in AR/inventory and AI growth being inventory-heavy should remain explicitly directional because the cash-flow reconciliation and Q1 product attribution are unavailable.

Unnormalized absolute NVDA and MU inventory balances remain low-value background for Dell and should normally be omitted from Writer unless a typed cross-company mechanism and comparable scale are supplied.
